findings.title: Completed inference can be submitted under a replacement native claim
findings.trigger: While round 1 inference is outstanding, an explicitly authorized operator settles and replaces its claim on the same SHA and actor.
findings.observed: Original inference publishes as replacement request nonce-3 / claim nonce-4 / round 2, although it started under request nonce-1 / claim nonce-2 / round 1.
findings.expected: Submit must atomically require the exact original claim, request, round and subject snapshot, and reject replacement reservations without publication or failure of the replacement claim.
findings.remediation: Extend native submit with an expected reservation/snapshot and verify that binding in all publication guards; pass the original claimed snapshot from the cloud worker. Add replacement-claim-during-inference regression coverage for both native subject types.
